_: The 1280x640 social preview card. Override serve/path/out; the rest is fixed.
_serve: Leave it. capture.mjs resolves serve/out relative to THIS FILE's directory, so "." is the templates dir where og-card.html sits — not the target repo.
_path: og-card.html with the text in the query string; url-encode the spaces (%20)
_radius: Deliberately absent. This card is opaque and full-bleed — Slack, X and LinkedIn composite it onto their own background, where a transparent corner goes black or white.
